instruction: Place all the objects into the safe, then close the safe.
explanation:
All three objects—the light-colored pouch, brown plush, and yellow object—were placed in the safe and remain there. The lid is lowered but remains slightly ajar, with part of the plush protruding through the edge, so the closed-lid condition is not met.

SCORE: 0.75
reply:
At 50.000 s, the yellow object is released inside the safe, joining the light-colored pouch and brown plush. All three remain inside thereafter. The lid is still open then and never fully closes, so the score is 0.75.
